> *Copied from the original monorepo; host-specific hosting details have been generalized. Deploy the folder on any static host.*

# HexWorld Demo Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A self-contained HTML page that renders the real-world land masses as Civ5-style selectable hexes (each hex owned by a real country), with a 10-position seed slider + coarse/medium/fine size control producing genuinely different hex layouts, hosted at `<your-host>/labs/hexworld/`.

**Architecture:** A pure, node-testable generation core (`core.js`, UMD) turns embedded Natural Earth country polygons into a `Map` of land hexes via point-in-polygon at hex centers over an equirectangular world. A browser app (`app.js`) renders that map with PixiJS 8 (one Graphics fill-path per country, batched edge strokes), does hover/click hit-testing with **math** (pixel→cell), and drives all UI through DOM overlays. A tiny build script inlines PixiJS + data + core + app into one `index.html`.

**Tech Stack:** PixiJS 8.19 (browser bundle already at `packages/client/node_modules/pixi.js/dist/pixi.min.js`), Node 24 built-in `node:test` (no new deps), Natural Earth 110m admin-0 GeoJSON (baked once at build time).

## Global Constraints

- Standalone demo: NO imports from `@rtc/*`, no sim-core coupling (spec).
- Final `index.html` is fully self-contained: zero external network requests at runtime (spec).
- Baked world data ≤ 400KB hard cap (target ~250KB), ≥150 countries, continent property present (spec).
- Equirectangular projection, lat clipped to ±85°; world logical size **W=1800, H=850** (5 px/deg both axes).
- Pointy-top hexes, odd-r offset rows (odd rows shifted RIGHT by hexW/2).
- Size presets (pre-jitter hex radius): coarse 16.5, medium 8.8, fine 4.9 (~700/~2,500/~8,000 land hexes).
- Seed drives: ±8% size jitter + grid origin offset (dx, dy). Same seed ⇒ identical map (deterministic).
- Do NOT edit `deploy/README.md` (it has uncommitted user changes); report the new symlink in the final summary instead.
- All demo files live under `labs/hexworld/`; commit after every task.

## File Structure

```
labs/hexworld/
├── package.json          # {"type":"commonjs"} island so .js = CJS for node tests
├── tools/bake-data.mjs   # fetch NE 110m → src/world-data.js (generated, committed)
├── tools/build.mjs       # template + pixi + data + core + app → ../hexworld/index.html
├── src/world-data.js     # GENERATED — countries [{n,c,p:[{b:[4],r:[flat…]}]}]
├── src/core.js           # UMD pure core: rng, projection, PIP, hex math, generate()
├── src/app.js            # browser-only: Pixi rendering, pan/zoom, hover/click, DOM UI
├── src/template.html     # page skeleton + CSS + /*__PIXI__*/ etc. inject tokens
├── test/data.test.cjs    # node:test — baked data sanity
├── test/core.test.cjs    # node:test — rng/PIP/generate/variance/determinism
└── index.html            # BUILT single-file artifact (committed, served)
```

Root vitest globs only `packages/**/*.test.ts` — the `.cjs` node tests here cannot collide with the monorepo suite.

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `labs/hexworld/tools/bake-data.mjs`**

```js
// Bake Natural Earth 110m admin-0 countries → src/world-data.js (run once; output is committed).
import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson";

const res = await fetch(URL);
if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`fetch failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
const gj = await res.json();

const r2 = (n) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
const countries = [];

for (const f of gj.features) {
  const props = f.properties;
  const name = props.NAME ?? props.ADMIN ?? props.name;
  const continent = props.CONTINENT ?? props.continent ?? "Unknown";
  if (!name || !f.geometry) continue;
  const polys =
    f.geometry.type === "Polygon" ? [f.geometry.coordinates]
    : f.geometry.type === "MultiPolygon" ? f.geometry.coordinates
    : [];
  const p = polys.map((rings) => {
    const flat = rings.map((ring) => {
      const a = [];
      for (const [lon, lat] of ring) a.push(r2(lon), r2(lat));
      return a;
    });
    let minLon = 180, minLat = 90, maxLon = -180, maxLat = -90;
    const outer = flat[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < outer.length; i += 2) {
      if (outer[i] < minLon) minLon = outer[i];
      if (outer[i] > maxLon) maxLon = outer[i];
      if (outer[i + 1] < minLat) minLat = outer[i + 1];
      if (outer[i + 1] > maxLat) maxLat = outer[i + 1];
    }
    return { b: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat], r: flat };
  });
  if (p.length) countries.push({ n: name, c: continent, p });
}

const out =
  "// GENERATED by tools/bake-data.mjs — do not edit by hand.\n" +
  "// Source: Natural Earth 110m admin-0 countries (public domain).\n" +
  `const WORLD_DATA = { countries: ${JSON.stringify(countries)} };\n` +
  '(typeof self !== "undefined" ? self : globalThis).WORLD_DATA = WORLD_DATA;\n' +
  'if (typeof module === "object" && module.exports !== undefined) module.exports = WORLD_DATA;\n';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
mkdirSync(join(here, "../src"), { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(join(here, "../src/world-data.js"), out);
console.log(`baked ${countries.length} countries, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)}KB`);
```

### Task 2: Pure generation core

**Files:**
- Create: `labs/hexworld/src/core.js`
- Test: `labs/hexworld/test/core.test.cjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `WORLD_DATA` shape from Task 1 (only in integration-ish tests; core takes data as a parameter).
- Produces (module `HexWorldCore` in browser, `module.exports` in node):
  - `WORLD = { W: 1800, H: 850, LAT_MAX: 85 }`
  - `SIZES = { coarse: 16.5, medium: 8.8, fine: 4.9 }`
  - `mulberry32(seed: int) → () => float in [0,1)`
  - `unproject(x, y) → { lon, lat }`
  - `pointInRings(lon, lat, rings: number[][]) → boolean` (even-odd)
  - `countryAt(lon, lat, countries) → country | null`
  - `cellCenter(col, row, geom) → { cx, cy }`
  - `cellKey(col, row) → "col,row"`
  - `pixelToCell(x, y, geom) → { col, row }`
  - `hexCorners(cx, cy, size) → number[12]` (flat, pointy-top, corner i at angle 60i−30°)
  - `neighbors(col, row) → [ [col,row] ×6 ]` in edge order E, SE, SW, W, NW, NE — edge i of `hexCorners` (corners i → i+1) faces `neighbors[i]`
  - `generate(data, { seed, sizeKey }) → { hexes: Map<key,{col,row,cx,cy,name,continent}>, countryCounts: Map<string,int>, continentCounts: Map<string,int>, totalLand: int, geom: {size,dx,dy,hexW,vs}, seed }` (tests may pass `{ seed, hexSize }` to bypass presets)

```js
const test = require("node:test");
const assert = require("node:assert");
const core = require("../src/core.js");

// One fake square country: lon/lat in [-20,20] — big enough to catch many hexes.
const BOXLAND = {
  countries: [{
    n: "Boxland", c: "Testia",
    p: [{ b: [-20, -20, 20, 20], r: [[-20, -20, 20, -20, 20, 20, -20, 20]] }],
  }],
};

test("mulberry32 is deterministic and seed-sensitive", () => {
  const a = core.mulberry32(42), b = core.mulberry32(42), c = core.mulberry32(43);
  const seqA = [a(), a(), a()], seqB = [b(), b(), b()], seqC = [c(), c(), c()];
  assert.deepStrictEqual(seqA, seqB);
  assert.notDeepStrictEqual(seqA, seqC);
  for (const v of seqA) assert.ok(v >= 0 && v < 1);
});

test("pointInRings: unit square with a hole", () => {
  const rings = [
    [0, 0, 10, 0, 10, 10, 0, 10],   // outer 10x10
    [4, 4, 6, 4, 6, 6, 4, 6],       // hole 2x2 in middle
  ];
  assert.ok(core.pointInRings(2, 2, rings), "inside outer");
  assert.ok(!core.pointInRings(5, 5, rings), "inside hole = outside");
  assert.ok(!core.pointInRings(11, 5, rings), "outside outer");
});

test("unproject maps canvas corners to lon/lat bounds", () => {
  assert.deepStrictEqual(core.unproject(0, 0), { lon: -180, lat: 85 });
  const c = core.unproject(core.WORLD.W, core.WORLD.H);
  assert.strictEqual(c.lon, 180);
  assert.strictEqual(c.lat, -85);
});

test("generate: all hexes land in Boxland, counts consistent", () => {
  const res = core.generate(BOXLAND, { seed: 1, hexSize: 8.8 });
  assert.ok(res.totalLand > 20, "expected a bunch of hexes, got " + res.totalLand);
  for (const hex of res.hexes.values()) {
    assert.strictEqual(hex.name, "Boxland");
    const { lon, lat } = core.unproject(hex.cx, hex.cy);
    assert.ok(lon >= -20 && lon <= 20 && lat >= -20 && lat <= 20, "hex center must be inside the square");
  }
  assert.strictEqual(res.countryCounts.get("Boxland"), res.totalLand);
  assert.strictEqual(res.continentCounts.get("Testia"), res.totalLand);
});

test("generate: same seed identical, different seeds vary hex count", () => {
  const a = core.generate(BOXLAND, { seed: 7, hexSize: 8.8 });
  const b = core.generate(BOXLAND, { seed: 7, hexSize: 8.8 });
  assert.strictEqual(a.totalLand, b.totalLand);
  assert.deepStrictEqual([...a.hexes.keys()], [...b.hexes.keys()]);
  const counts = new Set();
  for (let s = 1; s <= 6; s++) counts.add(core.generate(BOXLAND, { seed: s, hexSize: 8.8 }).totalLand);
  assert.ok(counts.size >= 2, "seeds 1..6 all produced identical hex counts — jitter not working");
});

test("pixelToCell inverts cellCenter", () => {
  const g = { size: 8.8, dx: 3.1, dy: -2.2, hexW: Math.sqrt(3) * 8.8, vs: 1.5 * 8.8 };
  for (const [col, row] of [[0, 0], [5, 3], [2, 7], [9, 4], [1, 1]]) {
    const { cx, cy } = core.cellCenter(col, row, g);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(core.pixelToCell(cx, cy, g), { col, row }, `cell ${col},${row}`);
  }
});

test("neighbors: edge order + parity, symmetric", () => {
  // even row (0): E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE
  assert.deepStrictEqual(core.neighbors(4, 2),
    [[5, 2], [4, 3], [3, 3], [3, 2], [3, 1], [4, 1]]);
  // odd row
  assert.deepStrictEqual(core.neighbors(4, 3),
    [[5, 3], [5, 4], [4, 4], [3, 3], [4, 2], [5, 2]]);
  // symmetry: if B is a neighbor of A, A is a neighbor of B
  for (const [c, r] of core.neighbors(4, 2)) {
    assert.ok(core.neighbors(c, r).some(([c2, r2]) => c2 === 4 && r2 === 2));
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `labs/hexworld/src/core.js`**

```js
// HexWorld pure generation core — UMD-lite: node (module.exports) + browser (global HexWorldCore).
// No DOM, no Pixi, no I/O. Deterministic given (data, {seed, sizeKey|hexSize}).
(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === "object" && module.exports !== undefined) module.exports = factory();
  else root.HexWorldCore = factory();
})(typeof self !== "undefined" ? self : globalThis, function () {
  const WORLD = { W: 1800, H: 850, LAT_MAX: 85 }; // 5 px/deg on both axes
  const SIZES = { coarse: 16.5, medium: 8.8, fine: 4.9 };

  function mulberry32(seed) {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    return function () {
      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function unproject(x, y) {
    return {
      lon: (x / WORLD.W) * 360 - 180,
      lat: WORLD.LAT_MAX - (y / WORLD.H) * (2 * WORLD.LAT_MAX),
    };
  }

  // Even-odd ray cast across ALL rings (outer + holes) of one polygon.
  function pointInRings(lon, lat, rings) {
    let inside = false;
    for (const ring of rings) {
      const n = ring.length;
      for (let i = 0, j = n - 2; i < n; j = i, i += 2) {
        const x1 = ring[i], y1 = ring[i + 1], x2 = ring[j], y2 = ring[j + 1];
        if ((y1 > lat) !== (y2 > lat) &&
            lon < ((x2 - x1) * (lat - y1)) / (y2 - y1) + x1) inside = !inside;
      }
    }
    return inside;
  }

  function countryAt(lon, lat, countries) {
    for (const c of countries) {
      for (const p of c.p) {
        const b = p.b;
        if (lon < b[0] || lon > b[2] || lat < b[1] || lat > b[3]) continue;
        if (pointInRings(lon, lat, p.r)) return c;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function cellCenter(col, row, g) {
    const odd = ((row % 2) + 2) % 2 === 1;
    return {
      cx: col * g.hexW + (odd ? g.hexW / 2 : 0) + g.dx,
      cy: row * g.vs + g.dy,
    };
  }

  function cellKey(col, row) { return col + "," + row; }

  // Nearest-center over the 3x2 candidate cells around (x,y). Exact for points
  // inside a hex (Voronoi of centers == hex grid).
  function pixelToCell(x, y, g) {
    const r0 = Math.round((y - g.dy) / g.vs);
    let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
    for (let row = r0 - 1; row <= r0 + 1; row++) {
      const odd = ((row % 2) + 2) % 2 === 1;
      const c0 = Math.floor((x - g.dx - (odd ? g.hexW / 2 : 0)) / g.hexW);
      for (let col = c0; col <= c0 + 1; col++) {
        const cc = cellCenter(col, row, g);
        const d = (cc.cx - x) * (cc.cx - x) + (cc.cy - y) * (cc.cy - y);
        if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = { col, row }; }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  // Pointy-top: corner i at angle (60*i - 30)°, screen y down.
  // c0 upper-right, c1 lower-right, c2 bottom, c3 lower-left, c4 upper-left, c5 top.
  function hexCorners(cx, cy, size) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI / 180) * (60 * i - 30);
      pts.push(cx + size * Math.cos(a), cy + size * Math.sin(a));
    }
    return pts;
  }

  // Edge i (corners i -> i+1) faces neighbors(...)[i]: E, SE, SW, W, NW, NE.
  function neighbors(col, row) {
    const o = ((row % 2) + 2) % 2; // 1 on odd rows (shifted right)
    return [
      [col + 1, row],
      [col + o, row + 1],
      [col + o - 1, row + 1],
      [col - 1, row],
      [col + o - 1, row - 1],
      [col + o, row - 1],
    ];
  }

  function generate(data, opts) {
    const rng = mulberry32(opts.seed);
    const base = opts.hexSize !== undefined ? opts.hexSize : SIZES[opts.sizeKey];
    const size = base * (0.92 + rng() * 0.16); // ±8% seed jitter
    const g = { size, hexW: Math.sqrt(3) * size, vs: 1.5 * size, dx: 0, dy: 0 };
    g.dx = (rng() - 0.5) * g.hexW;
    g.dy = (rng() - 0.5) * g.vs;

    const hexes = new Map();
    const countryCounts = new Map();
    const continentCounts = new Map();
    const rows = Math.ceil(WORLD.H / g.vs) + 1;
    const cols = Math.ceil(WORLD.W / g.hexW) + 1;
    for (let row = -1; row <= rows; row++) {
      for (let col = -1; col <= cols; col++) {
        const { cx, cy } = cellCenter(col, row, g);
        if (cx < 0 || cx > WORLD.W || cy < 0 || cy > WORLD.H) continue;
        const { lon, lat } = unproject(cx, cy);
        const c = countryAt(lon, lat, data.countries);
        if (!c) continue;
        hexes.set(cellKey(col, row), { col, row, cx, cy, name: c.n, continent: c.c });
        countryCounts.set(c.n, (countryCounts.get(c.n) || 0) + 1);
        continentCounts.set(c.c, (continentCounts.get(c.c) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    return { hexes, countryCounts, continentCounts, totalLand: hexes.size, geom: g, seed: opts.seed };
  }

  return {
    WORLD, SIZES, mulberry32, unproject, pointInRings, countryAt,
    cellCenter, cellKey, pixelToCell, hexCorners, neighbors, generate,
  };
});
```

  button.active { background: #f0c96a; color: #10263f; font-weight: 600; }
  .hint { color: #6f87a3; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 6px; }
  #stats { left: 12px; bottom: 12px; right: auto; max-width: 70vw; font-size: 12px; }
  #stats b { color: #f0c96a; }
  #stats .chips { color: #9db4cc; margin-top: 3px; }
  #panel { top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 250px; }
  #panel h2 { font-size: 14px; color: #f0c96a; }

  .actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 8px; }

  #tooltip {
    position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: rgba(10, 22, 38, 0.95);
    border: 1px solid #f0c96a; border-radius: 5px; padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px;
    z-index: 10; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #tooltip .tt-country { color: #f0c96a; font-weight: 600; }

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `labs/hexworld/src/app.js`**

```js
/* global PIXI, WORLD_DATA, HexWorldCore */
// Browser app: Pixi rendering + pan/zoom + math-based hover/click + DOM UI.
(async function () {
  const core = HexWorldCore;

  const app = new PIXI.Application();
  await app.init({
    background: 0x0b1d33, resizeTo: window, antialias: true,
    resolution: window.devicePixelRatio || 1, autoDensity: true,
  });
  document.getElementById("map").appendChild(app.canvas);

  const world = new PIXI.Container();
  app.stage.addChild(world);
  const fillG = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const edgeG = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const selectG = new PIXI.Graphics();
  const hoverG = new PIXI.Graphics();
  world.addChild(fillG, edgeG, selectG, hoverG);

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const ui = {
    seedSlider: $("seedSlider"), seedInput: $("seedInput"), seedVal: $("seedVal"),
    sizeBtns: $("sizeBtns"), stats: $("stats"), panel: $("panel"),
    panelTitle: $("panelTitle"), panelSub: $("panelSub"), log: $("log"), tooltip: $("tooltip"),
  };

  let seed = 1, sizeKey = "medium", res = null;
  let selectedKey = null, hoverKey = null, userView = false;

  // FNV-1a name hash → stable per-country HSL color.
  function colorFor(name) {
    let h = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) { h ^= name.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); }
    h >>>= 0;
    return hslToInt(h % 360, 42 + ((h >> 9) % 24), 40 + ((h >> 17) % 18));
  }
  function hslToInt(h, s, l) {
    s /= 100; l /= 100;
    const k = (n) => (n + h / 30) % 12;
    const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
    const f = (n) => l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, Math.min(9 - k(n), 1)));
    return (Math.round(f(0) * 255) << 16) | (Math.round(f(8) * 255) << 8) | Math.round(f(4) * 255);
  }

  function regenerate() {
    res = core.generate(WORLD_DATA, { seed, sizeKey });
    selectedKey = null; hoverKey = null;
    drawMap(); drawSelect(); drawHover(); updateStats();
    ui.panel.classList.add("hidden");
    ui.tooltip.classList.add("hidden");
  }

  function drawMap() {
    const g = res.geom;
    fillG.clear(); edgeG.clear();

    // One fill path per country (fast: ~170 fill flushes, not ~8000).
    const byCountry = new Map();
    for (const hex of res.hexes.values()) {
      let arr = byCountry.get(hex.name);
      if (!arr) byCountry.set(hex.name, (arr = []));
      arr.push(hex);
    }
    for (const [name, hexes] of byCountry) {
      for (const hex of hexes) fillG.poly(core.hexCorners(hex.cx, hex.cy, g.size));
      fillG.fill(colorFor(name));
    }

    // Batched edge strokes: coasts (thick) + country borders (thin), one stroke each.
    const coast = [], border = [];
    for (const [key, hex] of res.hexes) {
      const pts = core.hexCorners(hex.cx, hex.cy, g.size);
      const nbs = core.neighbors(hex.col, hex.row);
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const nkey = core.cellKey(nbs[i][0], nbs[i][1]);
        const nb = res.hexes.get(nkey);
        const seg = [pts[i * 2], pts[i * 2 + 1], pts[(i * 2 + 2) % 12], pts[(i * 2 + 3) % 12]];
        if (!nb) coast.push(seg);
        else if (nb.name !== hex.name && key < nkey) border.push(seg);
      }
    }
    for (const s of coast) edgeG.moveTo(s[0], s[1]).lineTo(s[2], s[3]);
    edgeG.stroke({ width: Math.max(1, g.size * 0.14), color: 0x081221, alpha: 0.95 });
    for (const s of border) edgeG.moveTo(s[0], s[1]).lineTo(s[2], s[3]);
    edgeG.stroke({ width: Math.max(0.7, g.size * 0.09), color: 0x101b28, alpha: 0.8 });

    if (!userView) fitView();
  }

  function outlineHex(gfx, key, color, width) {
    gfx.clear();
    const hex = key && res.hexes.get(key);
    if (!hex) return;
    gfx.poly(core.hexCorners(hex.cx, hex.cy, res.geom.size))
       .stroke({ width, color, alpha: 1 })
       .fill({ color, alpha: 0.25 });
  }
  function drawHover() { outlineHex(hoverG, hoverKey, 0xffffff, Math.max(1, res.geom.size * 0.12)); }
  function drawSelect() { outlineHex(selectG, selectedKey, 0xf0c96a, Math.max(1.5, res.geom.size * 0.18)); }

  function fitView() {
    const s = Math.min(app.screen.width / core.WORLD.W, app.screen.height / core.WORLD.H) * 0.98;
    world.scale.set(s);
    world.position.set(
      (app.screen.width - core.WORLD.W * s) / 2,
      (app.screen.height - core.WORLD.H * s) / 2
    );
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (!userView) fitView(); });

  function updateStats() {
    const conts = [...res.continentCounts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .map(([c, n]) => `${c} ${n}`).join(" · ");
    ui.stats.innerHTML =
      `seed <b>${res.seed}</b> · ${sizeKey} · hex ${res.geom.size.toFixed(1)}px · ` +
      `<b>${res.totalLand}</b> land hexes · ${res.countryCounts.size} countries` +
      `<div class="chips">${conts}</div>`;
  }

  // ---- pointer: hover (math hit-test), click select, drag pan, wheel zoom ----
  function toWorld(e) {
    return { x: (e.offsetX - world.x) / world.scale.x, y: (e.offsetY - world.y) / world.scale.y };
  }
  function hexAt(e) {
    const p = toWorld(e);
    const cell = core.pixelToCell(p.x, p.y, res.geom);
    if (!cell) return null;
    const key = core.cellKey(cell.col, cell.row);
    return res.hexes.has(key) ? key : null;
  }

  let dragging = false, dragMoved = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
  app.canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    dragging = true; dragMoved = false; lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
  });
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
    if (dragging && !dragMoved && e.target === app.canvas) {
      selectedKey = hexAt(e);
      drawSelect();
      const hex = selectedKey && res.hexes.get(selectedKey);
      if (hex) {
        ui.panel.classList.remove("hidden");
        ui.panelTitle.textContent = hex.name;
        ui.panelSub.textContent =
          `${hex.continent} · hex (${hex.col},${hex.row}) · ` +
          `${res.countryCounts.get(hex.name)} hexes this seed`;
      } else ui.panel.classList.add("hidden");
    }
    dragging = false;
  });
  app.canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (dragging) {
      const dx = e.clientX - lastX, dy = e.clientY - lastY;
      if (dragMoved || Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 4) {
        dragMoved = true; userView = true;
        world.position.set(world.x + dx, world.y + dy);
        lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
      }
      return;
    }
    const key = hexAt(e);
    if (key !== hoverKey) { hoverKey = key; drawHover(); }
    const hex = key && res.hexes.get(key);
    if (hex) {
      ui.tooltip.classList.remove("hidden");
      ui.tooltip.style.left = e.clientX + 14 + "px";
      ui.tooltip.style.top = e.clientY + 12 + "px";
      ui.tooltip.innerHTML =
        `<span class="tt-country">${hex.name}</span> · ${hex.continent}` +
        `<br>hex (${hex.col},${hex.row}) · country: ${res.countryCounts.get(hex.name)} hexes`;
    } else ui.tooltip.classList.add("hidden");
  });
  app.canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
    hoverKey = null; drawHover(); ui.tooltip.classList.add("hidden");
  });
  app.canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault(); userView = true;
    const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15;
    const ns = Math.min(12, Math.max(0.3, world.scale.x * factor));
    const wx = (e.offsetX - world.x) / world.scale.x, wy = (e.offsetY - world.y) / world.scale.y;
    world.scale.set(ns);
    world.position.set(e.offsetX - wx * ns, e.offsetY - wy * ns);
  }, { passive: false });

  // ---- controls ----
  ui.seedSlider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    seed = Number(ui.seedSlider.value);
    ui.seedVal.textContent = seed;
    ui.seedInput.value = seed;
    regenerate();
  });
  ui.seedInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
    seed = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(ui.seedInput.value) || 0));
    ui.seedVal.textContent = seed;
    if (seed >= 1 && seed <= 10) ui.seedSlider.value = seed;
    regenerate();
  });
  ui.sizeBtns.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-size]");
    if (!btn) return;
    for (const b of ui.sizeBtns.querySelectorAll("button")) b.classList.remove("active");
    btn.classList.add("active");
    sizeKey = btn.dataset.size;
    regenerate();
  });
  ui.panel.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-act]");
    if (!btn || !selectedKey) return;
    const hex = res.hexes.get(selectedKey);
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent =
      `[seed ${seed}] ${btn.dataset.act} → ${hex.name} (${hex.col},${hex.row}) — placeholder, no effect`;
    ui.log.prepend(div);
  });

  regenerate();
  // Verification hook (used by the Playwright checks; harmless in normal use).
  window.__hexworld = { get res() { return res; }, get seed() { return seed; }, get sizeKey() { return sizeKey; } };
})();
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `labs/hexworld/tools/build.mjs`**

```js
// Inline pixi + data + core + app into one self-contained index.html.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = join(here, "..");
const PIXI_PATH = join(root, "../../packages/client/node_modules/pixi.js/dist/pixi.min.js");

let html = readFileSync(join(root, "src/template.html"), "utf8");

function inject(token, content) {
  if (!html.includes(token)) throw new Error("template missing token: " + token);
  // Guard: a literal </script> inside inlined JS would terminate the script tag.
  const safe = content.replace(/<\/script/gi, "<\\/script")
    .replace(/^\/\/#\s*sourceMappingURL=.*$/gm, "");
  html = html.split(token).join(safe);
}

inject("/*__PIXI__*/", readFileSync(PIXI_PATH, "utf8"));
inject("/*__DATA__*/", readFileSync(join(root, "src/world-data.js"), "utf8"));
inject("/*__CORE__*/", readFileSync(join(root, "src/core.js"), "utf8"));
inject("/*__APP__*/", readFileSync(join(root, "src/app.js"), "utf8"));

writeFileSync(join(root, "index.html"), html);
console.log(`built index.html — ${(html.length / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)}MB`);
```

## Self-Review Notes

- **Spec coverage:** data bake (Task 1), grid+seed+PIP generation (Task 2), rendering/UI/interactions/stats (Task 3), hosting (Task 4), Playwright verification + PNGs to Art (Task 5). Out-of-scope list respected — no terrain, no wrap, no sim coupling.
- **Type consistency:** `generate` returns `{hexes, countryCounts, continentCounts, totalLand, geom, seed}` — used identically in app.js and tests; `neighbors` edge order matches `hexCorners` corner order (E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE ↔ corners 0–5); data shape `{n,c,p:[{b,r}]}` consistent across bake, tests, core.
- **Known risk, sized:** headless WebGL for Pixi in Playwright — fallback documented in Task 3 Step 5. Origin directory-index behavior — fallback documented in Task 4 Step 2.
